Sections with live data push other admins' edits and gameplay changes while you look. Editors that need the game screen suspend the panel and bring it back; anything that opens the inventory closes it.

Media packs

WHIP's pictures, videos and map files come in media packs of at most 256 MB, so players download each once:

  • whip_media_clothing_male, whip_media_clothing_female: clothing pictures
  • whip_media_props: furniture (img/props/<model>.webp)
  • whip_media_previews: vehicles (img/vehicles/<model>.webp), NPCs, tattoos, emotes
  • whip_media_map: the map, blip icons and minimap tiles

They start in any order. Players get a new picture when you restart its pack; whip_core reads which exist at its start. A full category continues in a new pack (whip_media_props_2): after adding, moving or renaming packs, run node whip_core/dev/assets_index.mjs.

ACE permission

Without whip.devtools the commands do nothing, and the server checks the ACE again behind every action. A player with a WHIP permission that opens a section (Director access, say) gets /whip with only that section.

add_ace identifier.license:xxxx whip.devtools allow

To give someone the tools until the restart, see Dev tools until the restart.

Player Manager

Every player who has joined, online or not (the 1,000 most recently seen accounts). Open it in /whip → Players → Player Manager; it needs whip.devtools, checked again on the server for every action.

Finding and managing a player

Filter by All, Online or Banned, and search by player name, licence or character name. A player's page has:

PartWhat it does
ProfileIdentifiers, characters, vehicles, jobs, position and current vehicle, with action cards
Current StatsOnline only: every stat, HUD or not. Type a value and Apply; it's held to the stat's range and logged in the console. Health is in game units (empty at 100, full at 200)
VehiclesEvery car the account's characters own, with state, garage and fuel. Click one to open it on the Vehicles page
Their gameOnline only: a picture of their screen (WHIP's screens, not other resources') and their map position. Capture Player's Game takes a new one; pictures are kept 5 minutes and each is logged
Teleport To, Bring HereOnline only
Open InventoryOnline or offline (loaded from the database); asks which character first
KickWith a reason; adds an admin note
Temp Ban, Perma Ban, UnbanSee Bans below
Admin NotesAdd and delete notes
ActivityThe Activity Log of every character, 30 rows at a time; click an item to follow it in the Item Log
Give Dev ToolsDev tools until the next restart (below)

An account on two game clients at once (one licence) shows as two rows. Config.PlayerManagerSessionWarn adds a "2 SESSIONS" warning and an "ALSO IN" link.

Bans

Bans are checked on connect against every identifier (licence, Steam, Discord, FiveM): any match blocks the player.

Rank decides who can act. Nobody kicks or bans someone of their own rank or above, or lifts a ban placed by someone above them. An admin from server.cfg can't be kicked or banned from the panel. Nor can an account that shares a licence, Steam, Discord or FiveM identifier with one be banned: the ban would turn the admin away too. Someone given dev tools from the panel can be kicked or banned only by a server.cfg admin, and a ban takes the tools away. A ban a server.cfg admin placed (or one with no placer on record) is lifted only by one of them.

A temporary ban ends by itself. The player sees:

You are banned from this server.

Reason: [reason text]
Expires: 2026-03-18 22:30:00 PDT

Ban ID: #1

A permanent ban says "This ban is permanent" instead. The time zone is the server's.

Dev tools until the restart

Give Dev Tools adds the player's licence to the group.whip_devtools ACE group. FiveM doesn't save a group added at runtime, so a restart, or stopping whip_core, removes it. Only a permanent admin can give it, each grant writes an admin note, and a temporary admin can't grant saved rights (such as Director access).

Add these to server.cfg (they apply after a full restart):

add_ace group.whip_devtools whip.devtools allow
add_ace group.whip_devtools command.w allow
add_ace resource.whip_core command.add_principal allow
add_ace resource.whip_core command.remove_principal allow

The group gets /w and /whip, not the server console.

Banks

Every account holder and all their money, in /whip → Economy → Banks. It needs whip.devtools, checked again on the server for every action.

Who is listed

Every player with a character, every business (job) and every lore character, with or without an account; an account nobody holds gets its own row. Search by name, licence or account number; Most Money sorts by balance. With nobody picked, the page shows the whole bank: deposits, cash on characters, the last 24 hours and frozen accounts.

A holder's page

PartWhat it shows
Total moneyBank and cash. One button per character, and All characters
Net worth (assumed)An estimate, itemised (below)
TransactionsThe all-time count, and money in and out per day for 30 days. Moves between their own accounts don't count
AccountsOpen accounts, others' accounts they can use, and closed ones
Full logEvery bank transaction, filtered by in, out or account; Cash shows cash from the activity log

How net worth is worked out

PartValued at
Bank accountsBalance of accounts they own
CashFace value, wherever it is
VehiclesThe average asking price across resources selling it (SetVehiclePrices); unsold models count $0
PropertiesListed price, or $0
ItemsAverage price across shops selling it (free and other-currency prices ignored), in pockets, boots, gloveboxes, stashes and inside other items. Unsold items count $0 and are named
BusinessesEach owned business's accounts and shelves

A deleted character counts while it still has an open account, and is marked.

Changing an account

ActionWhat it does
New AccountOptional starting amount and reason. Doesn't pay Config.StartingBalance; Config.MaxExtraAccounts doesn't limit admins. A lore character has one account, named after its bank name
Name, Type, New ownerA character's main account stays personal and theirs: make another their main first. The old owner keeps manager access until removed. A business account follows the business's owner (set on the Jobs page)
Freeze, Make Their Main AccountFrozen: no money moves, even from here. Wages land in the main account
Add, Take, Move MoneyA reason is required and shows on the statement as Admin: reason. Add creates money, Take destroys it, Move needs the other account's number
Who can use itGive, change or remove access; Config.BlockOwnCharacterTransfers applies. Staff access to a business account comes from their rank
Delete AccountAsks where the money goes, then closes it for good (kept under Closed with its log). A living character's main account can't be deleted

Every action is logged as bank_admin on your timeline and the owner's.

How WHIP is built

whip_core is the base: every other WHIP resource, yours included, depends on it and reaches it only through exports. Add dependency 'whip_core' to fxmanifest.lua and call exports.whip_core:ExportName(...); other resources' exports work the same (exports.whip_gunny:ExportName(...)).

LayerWritten inWhat it does
DatabaseMariaDB or MySQLKeeps characters, items, cars and accounts between restarts
ServerLua 5.4, with oxmysqlDecides everything: every change is checked and held in memory here before it's saved
ClientLua 5.4, with FiveM nativesEach player's game: the ped, keys, cars, and messages to the screens
NUIHTML, CSS and JSScreens over the game: inventory, bank, character creator, admin tools
DUIHTML, CSS and JS, in the worldScreens in the world: 3D prompts, /me bubbles, NPC conversations, bay outlines, Director marks. One browser per system, made when first needed (Screens in the world)

WHIP needs OneSync. Cars are made by the server, so they stay in the world when their driver leaves.

Server Events

Events whip_core fires on the server. Listen with AddEventHandler; every payload is one table, typed in whip_core/types/events.lua.

AddEventHandler('whip_core:item:used', function(e)
    print(('Player %d used %s'):format(e.source, e.item))
end)
Any server resource can fire them. Before a handler pays out, gives an item or punishes someone, check the sender: if GetInvokingResource() ~= 'whip_core' then return end. A handler that only logs or updates a screen needs no check.

How WHIP names its events

whip_core:<what>:<what happened>, with one table: function(e) … e.source … e.item … end. Fields can be added later without breaking you. Names containing client: or server: are WHIP's own network messages, not events for you (see Client Events).

Players and characters

EventPayloadWhen
whip_core:onReady{ reason, resources? }whip_core is ready for registrations. reason: 'coreStarted' (it remembers nothing: register everything) or 'resourceStarted' with the resources that just started. Also on the client. Use Whip.register instead
whip_core:player:loaded{ source, charId, name, newCharacter, player }Character fully loaded. player is the data sheet, name the full name, newCharacter true on a first load. The client gets the same table
whip_core:player:logout{ source, charId, player, why }The character is leaving: why is 'logout' or 'disconnect'
whip_core:player:died{ source, charId, killer, reported }The server accepted a death. killer: the server id when the server saw a player do it (a car's driver counts), else nil. reported: the victim's game's account, for display only
whip_core:player:revived{ source, charId, how, reason }how: 'revived' or 'respawned'; reason: 'revive', 'respawn', 'revive:admin' or 'revive:self'
whip_core:character:created{ source, charId }New character created
whip_core:character:deleted{ source, charId }Character deleted
whip_core:flag:changed{ source, charId, name, value, was }A character's flag was set, or cleared (value nil)
whip_core:permission:changed{ userId, permission, granted }An account gained or lost a permission

Items and inventory

EventPayloadWhen
whip_core:item:added{ source, item, amount, count, reason, by }A player carries more of an item, by any route (export, pickup, purchase, give, stash drag, cash). amount arrived, count is the new total; reason and by ('by my_resource') when an export did it
whip_core:item:removed{ source, item, amount, count, reason, by }A player carries less: used, dropped, sold, given, stashed, taken by an export
whip_core:inventory:changed{ source }Any change to a player's pockets, including moves between their own slots. Once per change. Not for a quiet SetItemMetadata
whip_core:item:used{ source, item, slot, addr }Item used (hotbar or Use). slot is the slot's data, addr its address
whip_core:item:given{ source, target, item, amount }A player gave an item to another
whip_core:heldProps:lost{ source, tag, reason, by? }Props from your HoldProps (tag '<resource>:<tag>') left the hands without you asking. reason: 'replaced' (by is the new tag) or 'world' (moved to another routing bucket). GetHeldPropsTag(source) returns what's held now: a resource's tag, WHIP's 'emote', 'bar', 'give' or 'take', or nil
whip_core:container:opened{ containerId, source, charId }The server opened a stash on a player's screen (E or OpenStore; not the admin page). Their game may still decline it
  • Pockets only. item:added / item:removed fire for every change in what a player carries, but not for an item put in a stash, a rearrangement of their own slots, items inside a bag, or logging in.
  • No per-move event. inventory:changed says only that pockets changed: look again with GetInventory or FindItem. For move detail, use a panel's onValidate / onChange, or ask GetOpenStores(source).

Money

EventPayloadWhen
whip_core:bank:balanceChanged{ type, accountId, amount, actorCharId, newBalance, message, … }Any deposit, withdrawal or transfer. A 'transfer' has fromAccountId, toAccountId, fromBalance, toBalance instead of accountId and newBalance
whip_core:bank:accountChanged{ accountId, what }No money moved. what: 'label', 'type', 'owner', 'frozen', 'main', 'closed' or 'access' (Banks page only, not job rank changes)

Vehicles

The lifecycle (:created, :spawned, :despawned, :released, :deleted, :ownerChanged, :dataChanged) is in Vehicle events.

EventPayloadWhen
whip_core:vehicle:lockChanged{ vehicleId, plate, locked, source }Locked or unlocked (fob, lockpick, SetVehicleLocked, admin), only on a real change. source nil when no player did it
whip_core:vehicle:lockpicked{ vehicleId, plate, source }Lockpicked (with vehicle:lockChanged)
whip_core:vehicle:entered{ vehicleId, plate, source, seat, previousSeat? }Got into, or moved to, a seat of a framework vehicle, checked by the server. seat -1 is the driver; previousSeat nil when getting in. Taking the driver's seat puts a strip key into an empty ignition
whip_core:vehicle:exited{ vehicleId, plate, source, seat, left }Left the seat. left: 'logout' or 'dropped', nil for getting out. Getting out unlocks the car and returns a strip key; leaving the game changes neither
whip_core:vehicle:registered{ vehicleId, plate, model, session, source }A vehicle registered in the framework (first time only)
whip_core:vehicle:claimed{ vehicleId, from, ownerCharId }ClaimVehicle made an unowned car someone's: vehicleId the new car, from the old
whip_core:vehicle:plateChanged{ vehicleId, from, to }SetVehiclePlate changed a plate

World

EventPayloadWhen
whip_core:door:lockChanged{ doorId, locked, source, cause }Real change only. cause: 'press', 'lockpick', 'autolock', 'code' or 'released' (a HoldDoor ended); source when a player did it
whip_core:door:denied{ doorId, source, reason }A press was refused. reason is what they were told: don't show it to others
whip_core:zone:entered{ zoneId, key?, source }Entered a zone with trackPlayers = true (checked about once a second)
whip_core:zone:exited{ zoneId, key?, source, dropped?, removed? }Left it. dropped: left the server inside it; removed: the zone was removed
whip_core:time:changed{ hour, minute }Server time set (export or dev tool)
whip_core:time:freezeChanged{ frozen }Time frozen or unfrozen
whip_core:weather:changed{ weather }Server weather changed
whip_core:property:ownerChanged{ propertyId, ownerCharId, previousOwnerCharId, by }Given to someone, or made unowned (nil); every key is taken back. by: the charId who did it
whip_core:property:keyGranted{ propertyId, charId, by }A key was given
whip_core:property:keyRevoked{ propertyId, charId }A key was taken back
whip_core:npc:spawned · :despawned · :damaged · :killed{ npcId, tag, owner, … }An NPC from SpawnNpc (NPCs). Ask GetNpc before paying out

Shops and jobs

EventPayloadWhen
whip_core:shop:purchased{ shopId, charId, source, items, total, paymentMethod, mode }A purchase completed
whip_core:shop:opened / :closed{ shopId, source, charId }A player opened or closed a shop
whip_core:shop:created / :updated{ shopId, shop }Shop created (export or dev tool) or updated
whip_core:shop:deleted{ shopId }Shop deleted
whip_core:shop:priceChanged{ containerId, item, slot?, price, forSale }A stocked shop's item priced or taken off sale; slot when set from a shelf slot
whip_core:job:created / updated / deleted{ jobId, key, … }Made, changed (name, icon, ownerCharId, oldOwnerCharId) or deleted
whip_core:job:hired{ jobId, key, charId, source, roleId, role, by }Hired. source only while online
whip_core:job:fired{ jobId, key, charId, source }Fired (a deleted job fires only job:deleted)
whip_core:job:roleChanged{ jobId, key, charId, source, roleId, role, oldRoleId }Role changed
whip_core:job:clockedOn / clockedOff{ jobId, key, charId, source }On or off duty by any route, logout included; real changes only
Duty is also a state bag. Player(source).state.whipJob is the key of the job they're on duty at, or false: a resource that starts late can read it. The client fires clockedOn / clockedOff for the local player.

Director

EventPayloadWhen
whip_core:run:started{ run, startedBy }A run started (never a builder's Test). run is a DirectorRunView (Director: for other resources)
whip_core:run:ended{ run, outcome, reason, vars, payout, faultCard, stopping }outcome: succeeded, failed, calledOff, aborted or faulted
whip_core:run:playerLeft{ run, source, charId, why, by, runEnds }A player left before the end (logout, disconnect, or a script: by)
whip_core:run:playerJoined{ run, source, charId, by }A script added a player (AddPlayerToScenarioRun)
whip_core:run:signalled{ run, name, data, source }A Send Signal card fired ("alarm")
whip_core:scenario:switchedOn / :switchedOff{ scenario, name, rev, replaced | why, by }A scenario was switched on or off

Client Events

Events whip_core fires on each player's game, about the local player. Listen with AddEventHandler; each payload is one table, named as on the server.

Loading and life

EventPayloadWhen
whip_core:onReady{ reason, resources? }whip_core's client is ready for registrations (as on the server). Use Whip.register
whip_core:player:loaded{ source, charId, name, newCharacter, player }The character is in the world and the picture is back. The safe "player is ready" hook: PlayerData and inventory are populated. Same table as the server's
whip_core:player:spawned{}Just put into the world. After every load, and again for a new character when the creator closes
whip_core:player:died{ reconnected, respawnRefused }Died. reconnected: loaded in already dead. respawnRefused: a respawn came too soon, so the same death is back after a revived
whip_core:player:revived{ how }'revived' (where they lay) or 'respawned' (at a hospital)
whip_core:player:logout{ charId }Logging out to character select
whip_core:appearance:modelChanged{}The ped was rebuilt with a new model (the load, /charedit). It starts with the default walk, clipset and face: put yours back here
whip_core:devtools:modeChanged{ on }Developer mode on or off. Off at every join; HasDevTools() says where it is. For what only developers see; the server checks again
whip_core:permission:changed{ permission, granted }This account gained or lost a permission. WHIP shows nothing: tell them yourself

Jobs and the Director

EventPayloadWhen
whip_core:job:clockedOn / clockedOff{ jobId, key }Went on or off duty
whip_core:job:listChanged{ jobs }Hired, fired, promoted, a job renamed. jobs is what GetPlayerJobs returns
whip_core:run:joined / :updated{ runId, scenario, name, objective, countdown }In a Director run / its objective or clock changed. Never a Test. GetPlayerScenarioRuns() returns the same
whip_core:run:left / :ended{ runId, scenario, name, why } / { runId, scenario, name, outcome, payout }Left a run / it ended for them

Screens and input

EventPayloadWhen
whip_core:ui:stateChanged{ open }A screen or dialog opened (true), or all closed (false): IsAnyScreenOpen. A progress bar alone doesn't fire it
whip_core:ui:cleanScreen{ on }The screen went clean for a recording (Camera Creator). Hide your UI while on
whip_core:hands:blocked{ label, only }A BlockHands began. only: 'weapons', or nil for everything (which also runs the 'freeHands' moment). Put away what it covers
whip_core:hands:unblocked{}The last block went
whip_core:pad:deviceChanged{ pad }Switched between keyboard and pad (settled over 400 ms); swap your button hints here. Also once at start (Controller support)
whip_core:keyboard:opened / :closed{ id, owner } / { id }The on-screen keyboard (OpenKeyboard) came up / went. Leave the pad alone between them (Whip.padScreen does)
whip_core:nui:capsDetected{ chrome, has, colorMix, …, gameView }The browser's capabilities are known or changed: the GetNuiCaps table
whip_core:ask:cancelled{ token }whip_core gave up on a question (timeout, run end, logout). Take down your RegisterAskChannel screen

World and vehicles

EventPayloadWhen
whip_core:zone:entered / :exited{ zoneId, key?, label, group }Entered or left a zone. Match on key (the EnsureZone name), as on the server
whip_core:weather:layerChanged{ name, layer }A local time/weather layer set (layer its settings) or removed (nil)
whip_core:vehicle:entered{ vehicleId, entity, plate, seat }Got into any vehicle or changed seat. Driver: seat == -1, as on the server
whip_core:vehicle:exited{ vehicleId, entity, plate, seat }Got out of any vehicle
whip_core:property:entered / :exited{ propertyId, name }Walked into or out of a property (GetCurrentProperty follows)
whip_core:property:furnished{ propertyId, interiorId, count }Its furniture is up on this client
whip_core:property:unfurnished{ propertyId, interiorId }Taken away (walked off, interior unloaded or redrawn, furnisher opened)
whip_core:property:furnishStateChanged{ propertyId, interiorId, state }GetInteriorFurnishState changed: 'pending', 'done', 'none' or 'idle'. interiorId nil until first ready

WHIP's own network messages

Names containing client: are messages from whip_core's server to its own client. They're not events for you: they reach only a resource that RegisterNetEvents them, their arguments change, and several fire at the start of something. Use the events above.

MessageArgumentsWhen
whip_core:client:playerLoadedserializedDataLoading is starting (serializedData.isNewCharacter on a first load). Use whip_core:player:loaded
whip_core:client:playerLogoutnoneBack to character select. Use whip_core:player:logout
whip_core:client:updateCashcashTotalCash changed
whip_core:client:inventoryUpdate{ inventory, weights }Any inventory change
whip_core:client:vehicleLockStatevehicleId, lockedLock toggled (players near the car)
whip_core:client:vehicleKeysSynckeysTableKey cache updated
whip_core:client:notifymessage, kind, durationEvery server toast. Use NotifyPlayer(source, text, kind), or return false, text in a SecureEvent
whip_core:client:groundItemCreateddataGround item spawned nearby
whip_core:client:groundItemDeletedidGround item removed
whip_core:client:containerCreateddefContainer created
whip_core:client:containerDeletedcontainerIdContainer removed
whip_core:client:jobsSyncjobsTableJob data on character load
whip_core:client:jobClockStatejobId, stateClock state changed (true on)

Data Structures

The shapes of the tables the most-used reads and events return.

Inventory

-- GetInventory(source)
{
    player = {
        [1] = { item = 'food',        amount = 3, metadata = nil },
        [3] = { item = 'vehicle_key', amount = 1, metadata = {
            vehicleId = 42, plate = 'ABC123', model = 'adder'
        }},
    },
    accessory = {
        [4] = { item = 'id_card', amount = 1, metadata = nil },   -- slots 4 and 5 take anything
    },
}

Vehicle

Every server vehicle read (GetVehicle, GetVehiclesOf and the rest) returns this snapshot, as a copy.

-- GetVehicle(vehicleId)
{
    vehicleId   = 42,
    plate       = 'ABC123',
    model       = 'adder',
    displayName = 'Adder',     -- from the vehicle catalog; nil for a model it lacks
    class       = 7,           -- the same
    vehType     = 'automobile',
    session     = false,       -- true: nobody owns it (street traffic, or a temp car)
    temp        = false,       -- true: a SpawnTempVehicle car (a rental, a job van)
    secure      = false,       -- true: can't be lockpicked or hot-wired
    owner       = { charId = 1, name = 'Sam Reed', online = true },
    state       = 'out',       -- 'out' | 'garaged' | 'impounded'
    garage      = nil,         -- the garage's key while garaged
    coords      = vector3(-200.5, -1300.2, 31.0),
    heading     = 180.0,
    spawned     = true,
    entity      = 4610,        -- nil while not in the world
    netId       = 88,
    locked      = false,
    stats       = { fuel = 85.0, ... },
    data        = { ... },     -- your resources' keys; always a table
    properties  = { ... },     -- GTA vehicle properties
    storage     = { trunk = { slots = 20, maxWeight = 100, used = 12 }, glovebox = { ... } },   -- only when loaded
    occupants   = { ... },     -- only with { occupants = true }
}

Bank transaction

-- whip_core:bank:balanceChanged
{
    type        = 'deposit',   -- 'deposit' | 'withdraw' | 'transfer'
    accountId   = 1,
    amount      = 5000,
    actorCharId = 1,
    newBalance  = 15000,
    message     = 'Paycheck',
    ownerCharId = 1,           -- a deposit: whose account it is
    accountType = 'personal',  -- 'personal' | 'savings' | 'shared' | 'business'
    label       = 'Main',      -- the account's name
}
-- a transfer has fromAccountId / toAccountId, fromBalance / toBalance, and
-- fromOwnerCharId, fromAccountType, fromLabel, toOwnerCharId, toAccountType, toLabel

Examples

Short recipes for patterns the tutorials and guides don't show: repairing on the client after the server agrees, refunding a failed sale, vehicle parameters, reacting to shop events, and calling another WHIP resource.

Declare in Whip.register. Secure events, callbacks, actions and items registered straight from the top of a file vanish when whip_core restarts (the satellite helper). AddEventHandler needs neither. Items such as repair_kit aren't shipped: define them first with RegisterItem or Config.Items.

Mechanic: repair on the client

A choice on the bonnet's prompt. The server checks and takes the kit; the mechanic's own game repairs, because engine health is a client native that needs network control.

-- client.lua
Whip.register(function()
    Whip.core:AddAction({
        id          = 'repair',
        at          = { vehiclePart = 'hood' },      -- shows while the bonnet is open
        label       = 'Repair Engine',
        require     = { item = 'repair_kit' },       -- only offered to someone carrying one
        canInteract = function(ctx) return GetVehicleEngineHealth(ctx.entity) < 900.0 end,
        onSelect    = function(ctx) TriggerServerEvent('mechanic:repair', VehToNet(ctx.entity)) end,
    })
end)

RegisterNetEvent('mechanic:client:repair', function(netId)
    local veh = NetToVeh(netId)
    if exports.whip_core:TakeVehicleControl({ entity = veh }) then
        SetVehicleEngineHealth(veh, 1000.0)
    end
end)

-- server.lua
Whip.register(function()
    Whip.core:SecureEvent('mechanic:repair', {
        rateLimit = 2000,
        params = { {'netId', 'id'} },               -- refused if bad, never clamped
        near = {                                    -- beside that car: naming it proves nothing
            at = function(source, player, netId)
                local veh = NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId)
                if DoesEntityExist(veh) then return GetEntityCoords(veh) end
            end,
            range = 6.0,
        },
    }, function(source, player, netId)
        if not exports.whip_core:RemoveItem(source, 'repair_kit', 1, nil, { reason = 'repair' }) then
            return false, 'No repair kit!'          -- shown to the player, logged as refused
        end
        TriggerClientEvent('mechanic:client:repair', source, netId)
    end)
end)

Dealership: refund a failed sale

ChargePlayer returns a receipt; if a later step fails, RefundPlayer returns the money the way it was paid.

function SellVehicle(buyerSource, vehicleId, price)
    local receipt, err = exports.whip_core:ChargePlayer(buyerSource, price, { method = 'cash', reason = 'Car sale' })
    if not receipt then return false, err end

    local ok, why = exports.whip_core:TransferVehicle(vehicleId, buyerSource)   -- gives a key by default
    if not ok then
        exports.whip_core:RefundPlayer(receipt)
        return false, why
    end
    return true
end
Selling a new car? CreateOwnedVehicle(source, data, { giveKey = true, spawnAt = vector4(...) }) creates it, brings it out and hands over the key, undoing itself if any step fails. Only the payment is yours to undo.

Gas station: fuel is a vehicle stat

There's no SetVehicleFuel: fuel is a vehicle stat registered by whip_fuel (which must be running), read and written like any other. The 'vehicle' parameter resolves the id and checks the player owns the car.

local PUMPS = { vector3(49.4, 2778.8, 58.0), vector3(263.9, 2606.5, 44.9) }

Whip.register(function()
    Whip.core:SecureEvent('gasstation:refuel', {
        rateLimit = 2000,
        params = { {'vehicle', 'vehicle'} },
        near = { at = 'vehicle', range = 5.0 },     -- at (or in) that car
    }, function(source, player, v)
        local atPump = false
        for _, pump in ipairs(PUMPS) do
            if #(v.coords - pump) < 12.0 then atPump = true break end
        end
        if not atPump then return false, 'Drive up to a pump first' end

        local fuel = exports.whip_core:GetVehicleStat(v.vehicleId, 'fuel')
        local cost = math.ceil((100 - fuel) * 5)    -- $5 per percent
        if cost < 1 then return false, 'The tank is already full' end

        local receipt, err = exports.whip_core:ChargePlayer(source, cost, { method = 'cash', reason = 'Fuel' })
        if not receipt then return false, err end

        -- The last argument is the change's source, shown in Vehicle Stats Debug
        exports.whip_core:SetVehicleStat(v.vehicleId, 'fuel', 100.0, 'gasstation:refuel')
    end)
end)

Impound: anyone's car, and lockpick alerts

{ anyOwner = true, session = true } lets the 'vehicle' parameter take any car, street cars included. near = { at = 'vehicle' } checks where the car is now, not its last saved spot.

Whip.register(function()
    Whip.core:SecureEvent('impound:seize', {
        rateLimit = 2000,
        params = { {'vehicle', 'vehicle', { anyOwner = true, session = true }} },
        near = { at = 'vehicle', range = 8.0 },
    }, function(source, player, v)
        if not exports.whip_core:IsPlayerClockedOn(source, 'police') then
            return false, 'Only on-duty police can impound'
        end
        local owner = v.owner.charId and exports.whip_core:GetPlayer({ charId = v.owner.charId })
        if owner then exports.whip_core:RemoveVehicleKey(owner.source, v.vehicleId) end
        exports.whip_core:SetVehicleLocked(v.vehicleId, true)
    end)
end)

AddEventHandler('whip_core:vehicle:lockpicked', function(e)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(GetPlayerPed(e.source))
    TriggerClientEvent('dispatch:alert', -1, { title = 'Vehicle Break-In', plate = e.plate, x = coords.x, y = coords.y, z = coords.z })
end)

Plate check: re-check the job on the server

An action's require only decides what's offered. The server checks duty again before answering.

-- client.lua: on any car's boot prompt (the plate is at the back)
Whip.register(function()
    Whip.core:AddAction({
        id = 'run_plate', at = { vehiclePart = 'trunk' }, label = 'Run Plate', icon = 'P',
        require  = { job = 'police', onDuty = true },
        onSelect = function(ctx) TriggerServerEvent('police:runPlate', GetVehicleNumberPlateText(ctx.entity)) end,
    })
end)

-- server.lua
Whip.register(function()
    Whip.core:SecureEvent('police:runPlate', {
        rateLimit = 2000,
        params = { {'plate', 'string', 8} },
    }, function(source, player, plate)
        if not exports.whip_core:IsPlayerClockedOn(source, 'police') then
            return false, 'On-duty police only'
        end
        local v = exports.whip_core:GetVehicle({ plate = plate })
        if not v or v.session then return false, plate .. ': no record' end   -- street car or rental
        exports.whip_core:NotifyPlayer(source, ('%s (%s) is registered to character #%d'):format(plate, v.model, v.owner.charId))
    end)
end)

Shops: react to purchases and visits

Raise prices as items sell:

local basePrices = { food = 50, drink = 30 }
local sold = {}

AddEventHandler('whip_core:shop:purchased', function(e)
    local shop = exports.whip_core:GetShop({ key = 'dynamic_store' })
    if not shop or e.shopId ~= shop.shopId then return end

    for _, line in ipairs(e.items) do
        sold[line.itemKey] = (sold[line.itemKey] or 0) + line.amount
    end
    local catalog = {}
    for key, base in pairs(basePrices) do
        catalog[key] = math.floor(base * (1.0 + (sold[key] or 0) * 0.05))   -- +5% per sale
    end
    exports.whip_core:UpdateShop(shop.shopId, { catalog = catalog })
end)

Warn on-duty police when an armed player opens a shop:

AddEventHandler('whip_core:shop:opened', function(e)
    local weapon = GetSelectedPedWeapon(GetPlayerPed(e.source))
    if weapon == 0 or weapon == GetHashKey('WEAPON_UNARMED') then return end
    local shop = exports.whip_core:GetShop(e.shopId)
    if not shop then return end
    for _, cop in ipairs(exports.whip_core:GetClockedOnEmployees('police') or {}) do   -- rows are { charId, source }
        exports.whip_core:NotifyPlayer(cop.source, 'Armed customer at ' .. shop.name .. ': possible robbery!', 'warning')
    end
end)

Weapon shop: another WHIP resource, and Whip.core

Sell a pistol with whip_gunny (add dependency 'whip_gunny'). Once something has waited (GiveWeapon gives through AddItem), call whip_core through Whip.core, which returns even if whip_core stops meanwhile.

local COUNTER = vector3(21.6, -1106.5, 29.8)

-- client.lua
Whip.register(function()
    Whip.core:AddAction({
        id = 'buy_pistol', at = { coords = COUNTER }, label = 'Buy Pistol ($5000)',
        onSelect = function() TriggerServerEvent('gunshop:buyPistol') end,
    })
end)

-- server.lua
Whip.register(function()
    Whip.core:SecureEvent('gunshop:buyPistol', {
        rateLimit = 3000,
        near = { at = COUNTER, range = 3.0 },
    }, function(source, player)
        local receipt, err = exports.whip_core:ChargePlayer(source, 5000, { method = 'cash', reason = 'Pistol' })
        if not receipt then return false, err end

        local ok, why = exports.whip_gunny:GiveWeapon(source, 'gunny_pistol', nil, 'Pistol purchase')
        if not ok then
            Whip.core:RefundPlayer(receipt)
            return false, why
        end
        exports.whip_gunny:GiveMagazine(source, 'gunny_mag_pistol', 12, 'Pistol purchase')
        Whip.core:AddItem(source, 'ammo_9mm', 24, nil, 'Pistol purchase')
        Whip.core:NotifyPlayer(source, 'Pistol purchased!', 'success')
    end)
end)

The people whose work WHIP builds on.

  • DurtyFree: the GTA V data dumps behind WHIP's lists of the game's tattoos, weapons, NPCs, ammo limits, voice lines and props.
  • WildBrick142: Chameleon Paint [Add-On] 2.0, the colour ramps whip_autos' Chameleon paints need, installed beside WHIP as its own resource, chameleon_paint. With thanks to Disquse, who found how to make the game load them.
  • RPEmotes (TayMcKenzieNZ, Mathu_lmn, MadsL and its community, which grew from DullPear's dpemotes; its first repository is gone, and it carries on as rpemotes-reborn): many of the emote menu's emotes, their commands and their prop placements. The emote list, shared/emote_list.lua, is GPL 3.0 for it.
  • txAdmin (André Tabarra): many of the weapon names that death reasons show, under the MIT licence.
  • Regynate: GTA V's map traced as shapes, which the pause map and the 3D map are drawn from.
